gallery.title: File:Koffie verkeerd cafe MP Amsterdam.jpg
gallery.description: A "koffie verkeerd" in Amsterdam. Literally it's Dutch for "coffee wrong", meaning that it contains too much milk compared with a "normal" coffee with milk. It is the Dutch version of the Italian "caffèlatte"/"latte". A traditional Dutch koffie verkeerd is made with filter coffee and resembles a French "café au lait" but due to the fact that most venues now use espresso machines, the Italian version with a "caffè lungo" at its base, is more commonly found.

gallery.filename: The Perfect Architect in Military Art by Sebastian Fernandez de Medrano.png
gallery.title: File:The Perfect Architect in Military Art by Sebastian Fernandez de Medrano.png
gallery.description: Allegorical engraving from The Perfect Architect in the Art of War (1700), dedicated to the Duke of Medinaceli by Sebastián Fernández de Medrano. It symbolizes the martial and noble virtues of the dedicatee, featuring personifications of Faith and Fame crowning a tree of military glory. Latin motto: "Sanguis et Avorum, sacra quos Divos fecit, Martiaque virtus, Fama; bono merito venit tibi, a Medrano, Martis artificis labor." ("The blood of your ancestors, whom sacred virtue and the fame of war made divine, has deservedly come to you, from Medrano, the work of the craftsman of Mars.")
